vendor: Redfin Corporation (a Rocket Companies, Inc. company)
product_family: "Redfin AI" refers to the AI-powered features built into the consumer real estate marketplace at redfin.com, not a standalone AI product or separate legal entity: Conversational Search (natural-language home search), Ask Redfin (generative-AI virtual assistant for listing Q&A), Redfin Redesign (AI photo redesign of walls/floors/countertops), and a Redfin app inside ChatGPT. All run on Redfin's consumer platform infrastructure. Redfin Corporation was acquired by Rocket Companies, Inc. (NASDAQ: RKT) on July 1, 2025.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. redfin.com has no trust center or security page; the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use contain no reference to SOC 2.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No ISO 27001 (or 27017/27018/27701) reference found anywhere on redfin.com.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an AI-governance certification for the Conversational Search / Ask Redfin / Redfin Redesign AI features.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not mentioned on redfin.com.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence, and out of scope: Redfin is a consumer real estate listing/search platform, not a HIPAA-covered entity or business associate handling PHI.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Redfin does not process card payments directly on the core consumer site in a way that is disclosed publicly; no PCI attestation is referenced.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; not applicable to a consumer B2C product.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: "If you are located in the European Economic Area, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority if you believe our processing of your Personal Information violates applicable law." — this acknowledges EEA data-subject rights but the policy stops short of an explicit GDPR-compliance claim, Article 27 EU representative, or DPIA process, so it is graded as a partial/unconfirmed posture rather than a held certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: The Redfin Privacy Policy contains no statement about whether user data (searches, photos, chat interactions with Ask Redfin / Conversational Search) is used to train Redfin's own AI models or third-party models. Given Redfin Redesign involves uploading personal home photos and Ask Redfin / Conversational Search involves conversational queries, this is a material gap for buyers evaluating the AI features specifically. No opt-out mechanism for AI training is disclosed.
privacy.data_region: "Redfin is headquartered in the United States. You agree that we may store and process the information we collect anywhere in the world, including but not limited to, the United States." — no region-restricted or EU-data-residency option is offered.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Site is served over HTTPS/TLS (observed); no explicit written commitment to TLS for all data in transit found in the privacy policy.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Only a narrow, specific claim: "Your Redfin account password is encrypted on our server." No broader at-rest encryption commitment (e.g., for photos, messages, or PII) is published.

security.name: Vulnerability/security disclosure program
security.value: No public bug bounty or responsible-disclosure page found on redfin.com at the time of this review.

security.name: Account deletion
security.value: "You may delete your Redfin account on your My Redfin: Account Settings page under 'Close Account' section."

security.name: Data retention
security.value: "Redfin retains the information we receive as described in this Privacy Policy for as long as you use our Services or as necessary to fulfill the purpose(s) for which it was collected..." — retention period is need-based, not fixed.

products.name: Conversational Search / Search Assistant
products.data_scope: User's natural-language search queries, browsing/search history, location.
products.notes: Free consumer feature embedded in the main redfin.com site and app; no separate account tier or enterprise offering.

products.name: Ask Redfin
products.category: Generative-AI Q&A virtual assistant for listings
products.data_scope: Listing data plus the user's questions; answers drawn from MLS/listing data, not from private user records.
products.notes: Consumer-facing only, no B2B/API product identified in evidence.

products.name: Redfin Redesign
products.data_scope: User-uploaded photos of homes (walls, floors, countertops) processed by an AI image model.
products.notes: Involves uploading personal property photos; no explicit retention/training disclosure for these images was found.

products.name: Redfin app in ChatGPT
products.data_scope: Query data passed through OpenAI's ChatGPT platform in addition to Redfin's own systems.
products.notes: Introduces a second data processor (OpenAI) whose own security/compliance posture is not addressed in Redfin's privacy policy.

compare.pricing_model: Free to consumers (Redfin's revenue comes from real-estate brokerage commissions and Rocket Mortgage lead referrals, not from the AI features themselves)
compare.data_residency: United States-headquartered; policy explicitly reserves the right to process data anywhere in the world

flags: Identity note: "Redfin AI" is not a distinct company or product SKU — it is a set of AI features (Conversational Search, Ask Redfin, Redfin Redesign, ChatGPT app) inside the consumer site redfin.com, operated by Redfin Corporation. Any listing should make clear this is a feature set of the larger Redfin platform, not an independent AI vendor.

No public trust center, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or AI-governance (ISO 42001 / CSA STAR) certification found anywhere on redfin.com despite Redfin being a large, formerly-public (NASDAQ: RDFN) company now owned by Rocket Companies (NASDAQ: RKT). This is a genuine gap for a company of this scale, not just a startup-style absence, and should be flagged rather than assumed benign.

Redfin was acquired by Rocket Companies, Inc. on July 1, 2025. Any certifications Rocket Companies or Rocket Mortgage hold belong to the parent/host, not confirmed as extending to redfin.com or its AI features; do not attribute Rocket's compliance posture to Redfin without direct vendor-domain proof.

No disclosure of whether Ask Redfin / Conversational Search / Redfin Redesign use customer inputs (queries, uploaded photos) to train AI models, and no opt-out mechanism found. This is a material gap given personal photos are uploaded for Redfin Redesign.
Redfin app in ChatGPT introduces OpenAI as an additional data processor not addressed in Redfin's own privacy policy.
GDPR posture is only partially confirmed: EEA complaint rights are acknowledged, but no explicit GDPR-compliance claim, DPA availability, or EU representative was found.
